title.narrative: A Pathway to Sustainable Food Systems in Jordan

description.narrative: The Joint Programme (JP) “Unlocking the Olive Economy: A Pathway toSustainable Food Systems in Jordan” aims to contribute to thetransformation of the Olive and Olive Oil Value Chain (OOVC) in Jordaninto an inclusive, climate-resilient, and investment-ready sector whileproviding a strong, sector specific proof of concept for Food SystemsTransformation in the Country, reaching up to 80,000 actors - includingwomen, youth, and marginalized farmers—the JP ensures that thebenefits of transformation are equitably shared across generations andcommunities, within the value chain.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
